title: A simple formula for the average gate fidelity of a quantum dynamical operation
author: Michael A. Nielsen
actually_read: p1 entanglement fidelity definition and Eq3

source_finding: Entanglement fidelity and average gate fidelity are established process quantities; for unitary relative W the maximally entangled overlap is Tr(W)/d.
project_derivation: H/d^2 = native_probability * entanglement_fidelity(W) = native_probability * (((d+1)*average_gate_fidelity(W)-1)/d). This is a source-based re-expression, not novel process fidelity.
